Our results establish a framework for developing and optimizing axon-like amplification functionalities in nonlinear electronic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用金属-绝缘体相变材料制成的两端器件，在相变临界点通过负微分电阻效应实现了高达约11.5倍的信号放大，并成功放大真实神经形态器件产生的脉冲序列，为人工神经元与轴突的直接集成提供了新方案。
AI.motivation: 大规模神经网络中信号耗散会导致信息丢失和计算失败，生物神经系统中轴突负责局部信号放大，但将轴突功能转化为硬件（即紧凑、可扩展的放大器）面临巨大挑战，因为模拟人脑需要构建约100亿个互连神经元，每个都需要专用的放大器。
AI.method: 利用金属-绝缘体相变材料（MIT材料）制备简单两端器件；将器件工作在相变临界点，利用负微分电阻（NDR）效应实现信号放大；通过调节直流偏压、交流激励、串联电阻和温度等实验参数控制放大倍数；提出了基于可观测输运特性预测增益的模型。
AI.result: 实现了高达约11.5倍的鲁棒信号放大；成功放大了真实神经形态器件（neuristor）产生的脉冲序列；放大倍数可通过多种实验参数灵活调控。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了在非线性电子材料中开发及优化类轴突放大功能的框架，为人工神经元与轴突的直接集成开辟了新机遇。

title: Nematic Wigner crystals in rhombohedral multilayer graphene
summary: Recent experiments have reported evidence for Wigner crystals (WCs) in rhombohedral graphene. Here, we investigate Wigner crystallization in rhombohedral tetralayer graphene using projected Hartree-Fock (HF) calculations and time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) calculations. We first perform HF calculations with one electron per Wigner unit cell, and find nematic WCs (nWCs) that spontaneously break the threefold rotational symmetry $C_3$ and $C_3$-invariant WCs. In particular, there are two nWC regions in the phase diagram: one larger region at large displacement fields and low electron densities, and another smaller region at intermediate fields and high densities. Both the nWCs and the $C_3$-invariant WCs are valley-polarized states with zero Chern number, and have positive indirect gaps in the HF band structure. We then perform TDHF calculations to further test the local stability of the WC states. We find that all $C_3$-invariant WCs and half of the nWCs are locally stable, while the remaining nWCs are unstable towards WCs with two electrons per unit cell or metallic states. The predicted stable nWC phase can be identified experimentally by scanning tunneling microscopy through its anisotropic charge distribution or by angle-resolved transport measurements via a direction-dependent depinning voltage.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Hartree-Fock和TDHF计算，研究了菱方四层石墨烯中的Wigner结晶现象，发现了自发破缺C₃旋转对称性的向列型Wigner晶体（nWC）和保持C₃对称性的WC，并分析了它们的稳定性和实验可观测特征。
AI.motivation: 实验上已在菱方石墨烯中观察到Wigner晶体，但理论上对菱方四层石墨烯中Wigner结晶的相图、对称性破缺和稳定性尚不清楚，需要系统的理论研究来揭示其物理特性。
AI.method: 采用投影Hartree-Fock（HF）计算和含时Hartree-Fock（TDHF）计算方法，对菱方四层石墨烯中的电子进行Wigner结晶分析，研究不同电子密度和位移场下的相行为。
AI.result: 发现存在两种WC态：向列型WC（nWC）自发破缺C₃对称性，出现在两个相区（大位移场低密度区和小位移场高密度区）；C₃不变WC则保持对称性。所有WC均为谷极化、陈数为零的状态。TDHF显示C₃不变WC和半数nWC局部稳定，其他nWC不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 向列型WC是菱方四层石墨烯中稳定的量子相，可通过STM观测各向异性电荷分布或通过角度分辨输运测量方向依赖的去钉扎电压来实验验证。

title: Interface-Confined Superconductivity with Thickness-Independent Superfluid Stiffness in (Pb,Sn)Te/FeTe Bilayers
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures. Comments are very much welcome
summary: Interface-induced superconductivity in FeTe-based heterostructures provides a promising route toward topological superconductivity, yet the roles of the neighboring layers topology, symmetry, and electronic structure remain unresolved. In this work, we employ molecular beam epitaxy to grow Pb1-xSnxTe/FeTe bilayers and use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to track the evolution of the Pb1-xSnxTe layer from a trivial insulator to a topological crystalline insulator hosting multiple Dirac surface states. Electrical transport measurements reveal robust superconductivity throughout the entire composition range, with a nearly constant superconducting transition temperature of ~12 K despite substantial changes in the electronic structure and topology of Pb1-xSnxTe. Double-coil mutual-inductance measurements further reveal comparable superfluid stiffness across the topological phase transition and nearly thickness-independent superfluid stiffness despite large variations in the constituent-layer thicknesses, demonstrating that superconductivity is confined near the interface. These results establish that superconductivity in FeTe-based heterostructures is largely insensitive to the topology, crystal symmetry, and detailed electronic structure of the neighboring layer, supporting a primary origin in modifications to the FeTe layer. The coexistence of interface-confined superconductivity and tunable multiple Dirac surface states in Pb1-xSnxTe/FeTe bilayers provides a versatile platform for exploring topological superconductivity and interactions among multiple Majorana zero modes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子束外延生长Pb1-xSnxTe/FeTe双层异质结，发现超导性几乎不受邻层拓扑、对称性和电子结构变化的影响，超导主要源于FeTe层的界面修饰，且与可调多重狄拉克表面态共存。
AI.motivation: 在FeTe基异质结中，界面诱导超导为实现拓扑超导提供了有希望的途径，但邻层拓扑、对称性和电子结构的具体作用尚不明确，亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延(MBE)生长Pb1-xSnxTe/FeTe双层薄膜，利用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)追踪Pb1-xSnxTe从平庸绝缘体到拓扑晶体绝缘体的演化，结合电输运测量和双线圈互感测量表征超导特性。
AI.result: 在整个组分范围内，超导转变温度Tc稳定在~12 K，几乎不随邻层拓扑相变而改变；超流刚度在拓扑相变前后相当，且对邻层厚度变化不敏感，证明超导局域在界面附近。
AI.conclusion: FeTe基异质结中的超导性主要源于FeTe层的界面修饰，对邻层拓扑、对称性和电子结构不敏感；界面超导与可调多重狄拉克表面态的共存为探索拓扑超导和多Majorana零模相互作用提供了理想平台。

title: Planar Microcavities can Suppress Exciplex Formation and Increase the Emission Efficiency of Organic Semiconductors
summary: Optical microcavities are widely used to control the emission of organic semiconductors, but their ability to reshape the molecular pathways that precede emission remains largely unexplored. Here we show that embedding a ZnPc:TPBi blend in a planar Fabry-Pérot microcavity suppresses the formation of non-radiative exciplexes and removes bimolecular annihilation at high excitation densities, increasing the photoluminescence quantum yield by more than forty-fold under continuous-wave excitation. This enhancement is far larger than expected from the weak Purcell effect. Instead, transient spectroscopy, power-dependent photoluminescence and kinetic modelling point to a cavity-induced rebalancing of excited-state populations: long-range Förster energy transfer from ZnPc monomers to emissive aggregates is enhanced, allowing it to outcompete charge transfer to dark exciplexes. Electromagnetic calculations predict FRET enhancements of up to ~400-fold at relevant distances, consistent with the observed suppression of exciplex-mediated losses. Our results show that optical cavities can control not only how molecules emit, but also which excited states they form, opening a route to improved efficiency and reduced roll-off in organic optoelectronic and photonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，将ZnPc:TPBi共混薄膜嵌入法布里-珀罗光学微腔中，可通过增强长程Förster共振能量转移（FRET）来抑制非辐射激基复合物的形成和双分子湮灭，在连续光激发下将光致发光量子效率提升超过40倍，远超弱Purcell效应的预期。
AI.motivation: 光学微腔被广泛用于调控有机半导体的发射特性，但其在发射之前重塑分子激发态路径（如非辐射激基复合物形成和双分子湮灭）的能力尚未被探索。
AI.method: 采用平面法布里-珀罗微腔嵌入ZnPc:TPBi共混薄膜，结合瞬态光谱、功率依赖光致发光、动力学模型以及电磁计算，分析腔体对分子间能量转移路径的影响。
AI.result: 微腔使PLQY在CW激发下提升超过40倍，瞬态实验和建模表明腔体增强了从ZnPc单体到发射聚集体的FRET（预测增强达~400倍），使其在与向暗激基复合物的电荷转移竞争中占据优势，从而抑制非辐射损耗。
AI.conclusion: 光学微腔不仅能控制分子如何发光，还能控制分子形成何种激发态，为提升有机光电器件效率并减小roll-off效应提供了新途径。

title: Adverse Selection with Quality Variance: A Maximum-Entropy Approach
summary: The adverse-selection mechanism in markets explains how asymmetric information between buyers and sellers can drive high-quality goods out of the market, thereby causing market deterioration. In its simplest formulation, only the mean quality is used to describe the market, and this is insufficient to determine how fast the market deteriorates or how the quality distribution evolves. To resolve the two problems, we describe the adverse selection as a dynamic truncation of the quality distribution: buyers set an upper bound proportional to the mean quality by a rate $ξ$ that is larger than unity, and sellers whose quality exceeds this upper bound reject an offer and exit the market. The retained market is then characterized by the conditional distribution obtained after this truncation, and the corresponding evolution process is iterated until market quality reaches a stable state. This statistical approach gives three results. (i) We identify a mechanism for preventing complete adverse selection, defined as the process where the quality of the market is driven down to the minimum quality floor. (ii) A larger quality variance or a smaller price premium, defined as the amount by which the payment upper bound exceeds the current mean quality, raises the upper bound on the deterioration in mean quality. (iii) A maximum-entropy benchmark shows numerically how quality variance and the payment rate jointly determine market deterioration and the final stable quality platform. This approach also clarifies how market interventions can slow adverse selection: they may raise buyers' payment rate, reduce quality variance, or increase the minimum quality floor.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动态截断质量分布的方法研究逆向选择机制，发现市场不会完全恶化到最低质量，质量方差越大或价格溢价越小，市场恶化上限越高，并提出了减缓逆向选择的干预措施。
AI.motivation: 传统逆向选择模型仅用平均质量描述市场，无法解释市场恶化速度及质量分布演化过程，作者希望通过统计方法解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 将逆向选择建模为质量分布的动态截断过程：买方设定一个与平均质量成正比（比例系数ξ>1）的上限，超过该上限的高质量卖方拒绝报价并退出市场，保留市场用截断后的条件分布描述，迭代此过程直至市场达到稳定状态。
AI.result: (i)发现了阻止完全逆向选择的机制；(ii)更大的质量方差或更小的价格溢价会提高平均质量恶化的上限；(iii)最大熵基准数值实验展示了质量方差和支付比率如何共同决定市场恶化和最终稳定质量平台。
AI.conclusion: 市场干预可通过提高买方支付比率、降低质量方差或提高最低质量下限来减缓逆向选择。

title: DFT+U+V is equivalent to DFT+U with density-dependent hybridized projectors
comment: 8 pages with an additional 6 pages of supplemental material
summary: Hubbard-corrected density-functional theory (DFT+$U$) is a popular tool for first-principles modeling of materials with localized $d$ or $f$ electrons, but its on-site corrections tend to over-localize charge and break covalent bonds. Inter-site $+V$ corrections were introduced to counter this and are now widely used, but a formal justification has been lacking. Here we show that -- to first order in $V/U$ -- inter-site corrections are exactly equivalent to on-site DFT+$U$ evaluated on a density-dependent redefinition of the Hubbard projectors, hybridized with those of neighboring sites, providing insight into the explicit mechanism by which $V$ affects covalency. If the projectors are held frozen, as is common practice, the equivalence partially breaks down. Beyond reinterpreting the formalism, these results sharpen the questions of how $V$ should be computed and what the Hubbard subspaces fundamentally are.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了DFT+U中的位点间+V修正，在一阶V/U近似下，等价于在密度依赖的重新定义的Hubbard投影子（与邻近位点杂化）上评估的DFT+U，阐明了V影响共价性的机制。
AI.motivation: DFT+U方法广泛用于处理局域d/f电子材料，但其位点内修正易过度局域化电荷并破坏共价键。位点间+V修正虽已被引入以解决此问题，但一直缺乏严格的形式化理论依据。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，在一阶V/U近似下，推导了位点间+V修正与基于密度依赖的重新定义Hubbard投影子的位点内DFT+U之间的等价性。
AI.result: 发现位点间修正等价于在杂化投影子上评估的DFT+U，揭示了V影响共价键的明确机制；但若投影子被冻结（常见做法），则等价性部分失效。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅重新诠释了DFT+U+V形式化，还指明了V应如何计算以及Hubbard子空间基本性质等关键问题。

title: Geometry contribution to sound attenuation in double-Weyl semimetals
summary: The axial coupling of strain to the nodes of the simple Weyl semimetals leads to anomalous contributions to sound attenuation in such materials. However, in double Weyl semimetals, there is no such axial coupling. Strain instead couples as a symmetry-breaking director field that deforms the Fermi surface around each Weyl node. In this work, we show that absence of axial coupling in double Weyl semimetals implies a very different mechanism of relaxation due to sound. The deformed geometry of the Fermi surface is the only source of sound attenuation under these conditions. Thus, we identify a geometric contribution to sound attenuation in double Weyl semimetals that is entirely absent in simple Weyl semimetals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了双外尔半金属中声衰减的几何贡献机制，与简单外尔半金属不同，双外尔半金属中应变没有轴向耦合，而是作为对称性破坏的指向场使费米面变形，这种费米面几何变形是声衰减的唯一来源。
AI.motivation: 探究双外尔半金属中声衰减的独特机制，特别是其与简单外尔半金属不同的应变耦合方式带来的物理效应。
AI.method: 通过对比分析简单外尔半金属（轴向耦合）与双外尔半金属（无轴向耦合）中应变对电子结构的不同影响，建立基于费米面几何变形的声衰减理论。
AI.result: 发现双外尔半金属中声衰减完全来源于应变导致的费米面几何变形，这是一种简单外尔半金属中不存在的全新几何贡献机制。
AI.conclusion: 双外尔半金属中声衰减的物理机制与简单外尔半金属根本不同，其独特的几何贡献为理解外尔半金属中的声电耦合提供了新视角。

title: Mapping Order in Semicrystalline Polymers using Machine Learning of Nanobeam Electron Diffraction
comment: Submitted to ACS Macromolecules. Main text is 13 pages and 5 figures, 23 pages and 15 figures with supporting information
summary: Organic mixed ionic electronic conductors (OMIECs) are a promising class of polymer materials for applications spanning neuromorphic computation to energy efficient electronics and bioelectronics. Despite being highly tunable, the relationship between structural features and key performance properties such as charge carrier mobility is poorly understood. Scanning nanodiffraction in the transmission electron microscope (TEM) is a powerful probe for elucidating this structure-property relationship, but produces large, noisy datasets that are difficult to interpret because polymer reflections exhibit several distinct morphologies. To address the complexity, we trained a machine learning (ML) model to detect these polymer diffraction peaks and their intensities from synthetic data. Compared to correlative peak detection algorithms, the conventional method for analyzing nanobeam 4D scanning transmission electron microscopy (4DSTEM) data, we show that the ML model is significantly faster and outperforms correlative algorithms in almost all cases, opening up the possibility of near-live visualization of 4DSTEM experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习模型从合成数据中检测聚合物衍射峰及其强度，相较于传统相关方法，该方法更快且性能更优，有望实现4DSTEM实验的近实时可视化。
AI.motivation: 有机混合离子电子导体（OMIECs）的结构与电荷载流子迁移率等关键性能之间的关系尚不明确，而扫描纳米衍射技术产生的数据集庞大且嘈杂，传统方法难以解析。
AI.method: 训练机器学习模型来检测合成数据中的聚合物衍射峰及其强度。
AI.result: 机器学习模型比传统的相关峰值检测算法更快，并且在几乎所有情况下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该ML方法有望实现4DSTEM实验的近实时可视化，为OMIECs结构-性能关系的快速解析提供了新途径。

title: GPU-accelerated finite-temperature Lanczos method for Heisenberg spin systems with non-Abelian permutation symmetries
summary: We extend a recent GPU implementation of the finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM) for Heisenberg spin Hamiltonians, which uses only total-magnetization symmetry, to the full permutation symmetry, including non-Abelian point and space groups. For highly symmetric clusters such as icosahedral polyhedra, the multidimensional irreducible representations (irreps) of the permutation group reduce the block dimensions substantially further than any Abelian subgroup. Here, we provide a matrix-free formalism (avoiding explicit storage of the projected Hamiltonian) for using such symmetries. The implementation applies equally to Abelian groups, retaining the advantages of GPU acceleration. Several cluster topologies are built in; beyond these, symmetry groups can be supplied as site-permutation generators, with irrep matrices computed automatically, so that user-defined clusters run without any code changes. We demonstrate the approach in production runs on a single NVIDIA B200 accelerator for the s=3/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the dodecahedron (Hilbert-space dimension 4^20 ~ 1.1x10^12) and for the s=1/2 square lattice of 5x8 sites (M=0 dimension 1.4x10^11). With R=24 random vectors per symmetry block and 60 Lanczos steps, the dodecahedron campaign (with the largest iterated symmetry block having a dimension of 3.6x10^9) requires about 50 GPU-hours. The code is openly available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/ghasdeke/ftlm-pg-gpu, archived at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21445872.

AI.tldr: 本文在GPU上实现了有限温度Lanczos方法（FTLM），将其从仅利用总磁化对称性扩展到完全置换对称性（包括非阿贝尔点群和空间群），为高度对称的团簇（如二十面体多面体）大幅减少了希尔伯特空间块维度，并在NVIDIA B200加速器上展示了其处理极大维数系统的能力（如dodecahedron体系维度达~1.1×10¹²）。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU FTLM实现仅利用总磁化对称性（阿贝尔群），对于具有高度对称性的团簇（如二十面体），块维度仍然过大，计算效率受限。引入完全的置换对称性（包括非阿贝尔群）可进一步压缩矩阵块维度，从而模拟更大的量子自旋系统。
AI.method: 采用矩阵免存储形式，避免显式存储投影哈密顿量；自动计算不可约表示矩阵；支持用户自定义团簇拓扑，无需修改代码即可运行；适用于包括阿贝尔群在内的所有对称群，保留GPU加速优势。
AI.result: 在单块NVIDIA B200加速器上完成：s=3/2 dodecahedron体系（希尔伯特空间维度4^20≈1.1×10¹²，最大对称块维度3.6×10⁹）耗时约50 GPU小时；s=1/2 5×8方格体系（M=0维度1.4×10¹¹）。
AI.conclusion: 全置换对称性结合GPU加速可极大扩展FTLM的模拟规模，尤其是对高度对称的量子自旋系统；代码开源且易于扩展至用户自定义体系。

title: Ah-SCDFT:A general approach for superconductivity with an-harmonic corrections
summary: First-principles studies of superconductivity often neglect anharmonic effects (AHE), despite their crucial role in achieving quantitative accuracy in many materials. To bridge this gap, we introduce a general computational approach, termed anharmonic superconducting density functional theory (ah-SCDFT) which systematically incorporates anharmonic corrections into standard SCDFT. This approach allows for high-fidelity predictions of superconducting properties with only a modest increase in computational cost for a limited number of superconducting calculation convergence steps. We demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of ah-SCDFT by applying it to the prototypical superconductor MgB2, accurately reproducing its superconducting behavior under both ambient conditions and applied pressure in excellent agreement with experiment. Our results establish ah-SCDFT as a powerful, efficient, and broadly applicable approach for quantitatively reliable studies of superconductivity and a promising tool for the prediction of new superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的计算方法——非谐超导密度泛函理论（ah-SCDFT），通过系统地将非谐效应纳入标准SCDFT中，以更高的精度预测超导性质，并在MgB2材料中验证了其与实验高度一致的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的超导第一性原理研究常忽略非谐效应，但非谐效应对实现定量准确性至关重要。为此，作者希望开发一种能够系统性地纳入非谐修正的计算方法，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 提出ah-SCDFT方法，在标准SCDFT框架中系统地引入非谐修正，仅需在有限的超导计算收敛步骤中增加适量计算成本。
AI.result: 将ah-SCDFT应用于典型超导体MgB2，在常压和施加压力条件下均准确复现了其超导行为，与实验结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: ah-SCDFT是一种高效、广泛适用且定量可靠的超导研究方法，为预测新型超导材料提供了有力的工具。

title: Richards' equation as a hydrodynamic limit: Chapman--Enskog reduction of the continuum kinetic equation for unsaturated soil water
summary: Richards' equation for unsaturated water flow is derived from the kinetic theory of the pore-filling distribution g(r,x,t) of a companion paper. It separates two limits that macroscopic theory usually conflates. The spatial limit is purely kinematic: contracting the representative elementary volume (REV) to a point yields the closed continuum kinetic equation (CKE) d_t g + div F = C[g], with F a pore-resolved pre-closure flux and C[g] the occupancy-gated redistribution operator. The dynamics lies in the temporal limit, the subject of this paper: a Chapman-Enskog (CE) reduction of the CKE controlled by the Damkohler number Da (redistribution time over forcing time), the structural analogue of the passage from Boltzmann to Navier-Stokes. The linearized redistribution operator J is self-adjoint and negative semidefinite in the mass inner product, with a one-dimensional kernel fixing a single invariant (water) and hence one macroscopic equation; the CE hierarchy inverts the same J at every order, only the source changing. Four results follow: the equilibrium step defines the retention curve; the linearized water budget plus the inter-REV source set the first-order equation; its solvability is mass conservation, i.e. Richards' equation; and the response function gives the macroscopic flux, identifying the conductivity K as a first-order transport coefficient, the counterpart of viscosity. Mean-field reduction recovers the standard integral formula; the serial-path correction gives Mualem's heterogeneity penalty. A bimodal pore-size distribution opens a gap in the relaxation spectrum; projecting onto the bands and applying CE within each, with cross-band relaxation surviving at O(1), derives the dual- and multiple-permeability models from first principles, the exchange coefficient set by inter-band connectivity. When Da is not small the expansion breaks down and the full CKE is needed.

AI.tldr: 本文从孔隙填充分布g(r,x,t)的动理论出发推导Richards非饱和水流方程，通过Chapman-Enskog展开将空间极限与时间极限分离，证明Richards方程是CKE的一阶约化结果，并首次从第一性原理导出了双/多渗透率模型。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观理论将空间极限与时间极限混为一谈，无法清晰揭示非饱和流动的多尺度结构。作者意图从孔隙尺度的动理论出发，严格分离这两个极限，为Richards方程提供更坚实的基础，并统一解释双渗透率模型等经验公式。
AI.method: 1) 从伴随论文的动理论出发，建立闭连续动理论方程(CKE)；2) 利用Chapman-Enskog展开，以Damkohler数Da（重分布时间/强迫时间）为小参数进行渐进约化；3) 利用线性化重分布算子的自伴性与负半定性，构建CE层级反演；4) 对双峰孔隙分布采用谱间隙投影方法导出多渗透率模型。
AI.result: 1) 平衡步定义持水曲线；2) 一阶方程即Richards方程；3) 导出的宏观通量中，水力传导率K作为一阶输运系数出现（类比于粘度）；4) 均值场约化恢复标准积分公式，串联路径校正给出Mualem异质性罚项；5) 双峰分布导致松弛谱出现间隙，跨带松弛在O(1)存活，导出双/多渗透率模型。
AI.conclusion: Richards方程是CKE的一阶Chapman-Enskog约化结果，动理论框架提供了从孔隙尺度到宏观尺度的严格衔接路径。当Da不小（即非平衡效应显著）时，展开失效，需要直接求解完整的CKE方程。

title: Spin-valley-layer coupling with dual control via stacking and electric field in antiferromagnetic bilayer Janus YIBr
summary: The modification and enhancement of antiferromagnetic two-dimensional semiconductor is considered crucial for realizing novel electronic properties and facilitating promising applications. For this purpose, we investigate six antiferromagnetic 2D bilayer Janus YIBr structures with different stacking variations by means of first-principles calculation and an effective low-energy model. The calculation of magnetic anisotropy energy shows that the direction of easy axis varies with different stacking. First-principles-calculated energy bands reveal that there is a Dirac relativistic dispersion relation in the valence band in a wide energy window of 0.3 eV at least. The calculations for spin, atom properties and Berry curvature description show that there is spin, valley and layer coupling with spin splitting, valley polarization and quantum valley Hall insulators can be achieved in the bilayer Janus structures. Further analyses of the effect of external electric field can be used to control spin, valley and layer of the hole near the Fermi level. These can be useful in future exploration for novel properties, control methods and more functionalities in bilayer Janus structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过第一性原理计算和有效低能模型，研究了六种不同堆叠方式的双层Janus YIBr反铁磁二维半导体结构，发现了宽能窗内的狄拉克色散关系、自旋-谷-层耦合效应，并证实外电场可调控费米能级附近空穴的自旋、谷和层属性。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁二维半导体的修饰和增强被认为是实现新型电子特性和促进有前景应用的关键，但目前对此类材料中自旋、谷和层自由度的协同调控机制仍缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算和有效低能模型，研究了六种不同堆叠方式的双层Janus YIBr结构，计算了磁各向异性能、能带结构、自旋和原子特性以及贝里曲率，并分析了外电场的影响。
AI.result: 发现易轴方向随堆叠方式变化；价带中存在至少0.3 eV宽能窗的狄拉克相对论色散关系；实现了自旋劈裂、谷极化及量子谷霍尔绝缘体；外电场可有效调控费米能级附近空穴的自旋、谷和层属性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在双层Janus结构中探索新型电子特性、控制方法和更多功能提供了有用依据。

title: Ordinary Disordered Materials Can Carry Hyperuniform Physical Fields
summary: Fluctuations in disordered matter play a central role in determining material properties and physical responses. Recent studies have identified an exotic class of systems known as structurally hyperuniform materials, in which large-scale density fluctuations are anomalously suppressed through special spatial organization of particles, phases, or microstructural features. Here we demonstrate that ordinary, structurally nonhyperuniform disordered materials can nevertheless support hyperuniform physical scalar, vector, and tensor fields such as charge, bound current, vorticity, defect density, and stress. We develop a general theoretical framework in which a physical field is generated from a more primitive parent field through a local physical operator. In Fourier space, the spectrum of the derived field is determined by the product of the parent-field spectrum and the Fourier symbol of the operator. When the operator embodies a local gauge-like constraint, its Fourier symbol possesses zeros at small wavenumber, eliminating the corresponding long-wavelength fluctuations. As a consequence, the derived field exhibits complete suppression of infinite-wavelength intensity fluctuations, irrespective of the large-scale disorder and nonhyperuniformity of the parent field. We demonstrate this mechanism in elastic, electrostatic, and magnetostatic settings, showing that operator-generated incompatibility, bound charge, and bound-current fields can become hyperuniform even when their parent eigenstrain, polarization, or magnetization fields remain conventionally disordered. These findings broaden the notion of hyperuniformity from a structural property of matter to a universal field phenomenon generated by local physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，即使材料结构本身不是超均匀的（即具有常规的大尺度密度涨落），通过局部物理算子（如散度、旋度等约束）生成的物理场（电荷、束缚电流、涡度、缺陷密度、应力等）可以表现出超均匀性——即长波涨落被完全抑制。作者建立了普适理论框架，并在弹性、静电、磁静等系统中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 传统认知中，超均匀性被视为材料结构的一种固有属性。作者试图突破这一局限，探索是否非超均匀的母体材料也能产生超均匀的物理场，从而将超均匀性的概念从结构性质推广为更普遍的场现象。
AI.method: 提出理论框架：物理场由更原始的母场通过局部物理算子生成。在傅里叶空间中，导出场的谱等于母场谱乘以算子的傅里叶符号。当算子具有局域规范约束（如散度为零等），其傅里叶符号在小波数处存在零点，从而消除长波涨落，使导出场在无限波长处完全抑制强度涨落。在弹性（特征应变→不协调场）、静电（极化→束缚电荷）、磁静（磁化→束缚电流）等系统中进行了演示。
AI.result: 证明了即使母场（如特征应变、极化、磁化）具有常规的非超均匀无序结构，通过局部约束算子生成的导出场（不协调场、束缚电荷、束缚电流）可以成为超均匀的——即其无限波长处的涨落完全被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 超均匀性不应仅被理解为材料结构的一种属性，而是可以由局部物理约束产生的普适场现象。这拓宽了超均匀性的概念边界，并为设计和理解无序材料中的物理场行为提供了新的视角。

title: Gate-tunable giant anomalous Hall effect in magnetic topological insulator bilayer
summary: In the two-dimensional limit, the intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4 provides a compelling platform for exploring thickness-dependent quantum states and their evolution under external perturbations. Using first-principles calculations and classical Heisenberg Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that electrostatic gating and surface chemical functionalization can drive a systematic crossover from the topological to the conventional anomalous Hall regime. This transition is governed by the simultaneous shift of the Fermi level away from the topological gap and a reversal of interlayer coupling from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic order. Results reveal that hole doping drives the Fermi level into the valence bands, inducing an exceptionally high anomalous Hall conductivity of 1127 S/cm arising from Berry curvature hot spots. In contrast, surface chemical doping drives a topological state where intrinsic $σ_{xy}$ is reduced from $e^2/h$ to $\sim 0.86\ e^2/h$ by the spectral coexistance of chiral edge mode with metallic bulk states of the two-dimensional film. Furthermore, we show that both tuning routes significantly enhance in-plane exchange interactions, leading to a substantial increase in the magnetic ordering temperature relative to the pristine bilayer. These results establish a versatile framework for the simultaneous engineering of topological, magnetic, and transport properties in ultrathin MnBi2Te4, offering direct implications for the development of reconfigurable quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和蒙特卡洛模拟，证明了静电门控和表面化学功能化可以在超薄MnBi2Te4中实现拓扑反常霍尔效应的可控转变，并显著提升磁有序温度。
AI.motivation: 探索二维极限下MnBi2Te4中厚度依赖的量子态及其在外界扰动下的演化，实现对拓扑、磁性和输运性质的同时调控。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算和经典海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟，研究静电门控和表面化学功能化两种调控手段对MnBi2Te4双层薄膜的影响。
AI.result: 空穴掺杂驱动费米能级进入价带，产生高达1127 S/cm的反常霍尔电导；表面化学掺杂使拓扑态的内禀σxy从e²/h降至~0.86 e²/h；两种调控均显著增强面内交换作用，提高磁有序温度。
AI.conclusion: 建立了在超薄MnBi2Te4中同时工程化拓扑、磁性和输运性质的多功能框架，为可重构量子器件的发展提供了直接指导。

title: Oval-shaped resonance distortion as a signature of quasiparticle heating effect in a niobium superconducting resonator
summary: We investigate the nonlinear behavior of a superconducting microwave resonator subjected to a dissipative mechanism where the associated quality factor (Q factor) decreases with increasing dissipated power, leading to a dissipative feedback effect. By modifying the Rothwarf-Taylor equations, we establish a macroscopic quasiparticle heating (QPH) model that directly links the quality factor to the microwave readout power. The key finding is the identification of a distinctive oval-shaped distortion in the resonance circle in the complex plane. This distortion serves as a practical experimental signature for identifying the readout power regime in which QPH dominates the loss, under conditions where other nonlinear mechanisms are sufficiently weak. To validate the model, we design and fabricate a niobium (Nb) half-wavelength coplanar waveguide (CPW) resonator and conduct systematic bath temperature and readout power sweeps. The model provides a well fit to the observed oval-shaped resonance circle distortion across a wide range of operating conditions, confirming the QPH mechanism as the primary source of the dissipative non-linearity in the parameter space investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过改进Rothwarf-Taylor方程，建立了准粒子加热（QPH）模型，揭示了超导微波谐振器中因耗散功率增加导致Q因子降低的非线性行为，并识别出复平面中共振圆畸变为椭圆形的实验特征，通过铌基CPW谐振器实验验证了该模型。
AI.motivation: 研究超导微波谐振器中因耗散功率增加导致Q因子降低的非线性机制，特别是准粒子加热效应，并寻找一种实用的实验特征来识别该效应占主导的读出声功率区间。
AI.method: 改进Rothwarf-Taylor方程，建立宏观准粒子加热（QPH）模型，将Q因子与微波读出声功率直接关联；设计并制备铌基半波长共面波导谐振器，进行系统性的浴温度与读出声功率扫描实验。
AI.result: 识别出复平面中共振圆呈现独特的椭圆形畸变，该特征可作为QPH主导损耗的实验标志；模型在广泛的实验条件下很好地拟合了观测到的椭圆形共振圆畸变。
AI.conclusion: QPH机制是所研究参数空间中耗散非线性的主要来源，椭圆形共振圆畸变可作为识别该机制的实用实验特征。

title: On the use of the Belopol'skaya-Daletskii representation of a diffusion on a Riemann manifold to construct path integrals
summary: We show that the Belopol'skaya-Daletskii formulation of stochastic differential equations on a Riemann manifold offers an elementary way to construct equivariant representations of finite-dimensional approximations to the path measure of a diffusion. The key ingredient is the use of the exponential map to describe increments of the diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Belopol'skaya-Daletskii公式的黎曼流形上随机微分方程新方法，利用指数映射描述扩散增量，从而构建扩散路径测度的有限维近似等变表示。
AI.motivation: 在黎曼流形上构建扩散路径测度的等变表示是困难的问题，现有方法较为复杂。作者希望找到一种更简单、更基础的方法来实现这一目标。
AI.method: 采用Belopol'skaya-Daletskii随机微分方程公式，利用指数映射描述扩散的增量，从而构建扩散路径测度的有限维近似表示。
AI.result: 成功建立了扩散路径测度的有限维近似的等变表示，且方法相较于传统方法更为基础。
AI.conclusion: Belopol'skaya-Daletskii公式为在黎曼流形上构造扩散的等变表示提供了一种简洁有效的途径，指数映射是关键工具。

title: Layer Edelstein Effect
summary: Electrical control of magnetism represents a fundamental route toward next-generation spintronic functionalities. In this Letter, we introduce a universal current-induced spin phenomenon in bilayer systems, termed the layer Edelstein effect (LEE), which serves as the natural counterpart of the layer Hall effect in real space. It is defined by the emergence of layer-resolved spin magnetizations with opposite components on the top and bottom layers, driven by an in-plane charge current and controllable by an external electric field. We establish the general existence of the LEE using a minimal bilayer $k \cdot p$ theory. By combining symmetry analysis with a general bilayer stacking framework, we derive a model-independent symmetry criterion demonstrating that the LEE is generically allowed in a broad class of nonmagnetic bilayer stacking systems. We further show that the LEE admits two universal manifestations: explicit layer-opposite spin magnetization components mandated directly by symmetry, and components become activated upon symmetry reduction by external electric fields. First-principles calculations on stacked bilayer MoSSe, MoTe$_2$ and WTe$_2$ confirm the predicted effect and illustrate their experimental feasibility. Our work establishes the LEE as a generic symmetry-governed response of bilayer systems, providing a unified conceptual framework for electrically generating and manipulating layer-resolved spin polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统论证了层埃德斯坦效应（LEE），即双层体系中由面内电流驱动的层分辨自旋磁化现象，并通过对称性分析和第一性原理计算验证了其普适存在性。
AI.motivation: 实现电学调控磁性是下一代自旋电子学功能的核心目标。现有电控自旋效应多局限于单层体系，缺乏对双层体系中电流诱导层分辨自旋极化的系统性理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立双层体系中电流驱动层分辨自旋极化的普适理论框架。
AI.method: 1）通过最小双层k·p理论建立LEE的基本物理图像；2）结合对称性分析与一般双层堆叠框架，推导模型无关的对称性判据；3）利用第一性原理计算在MoSSe、MoTe₂和WTe₂双层堆叠体系中验证LEE的存在性。
AI.result: LEE在非磁性双层堆叠体系中普遍存在，包含两种表现形式：由对称性直接强制要求的显性层反对称自旋磁化分量，以及在外电场作用下对称性破缺后被激活的可调分量。第一性原理计算在不同双层材料中均证实了该效应。
AI.conclusion: 本研究确立了LEE作为双层体系中受对称性调控的普适响应，为电学产生和操纵层分辨自旋极化提供了统一的概念框架，对发展下一代自旋电子学器件具有重要指导意义。

title: Harnessing disorder to decouple extension and shear in kirigami metamaterials
summary: Kirigami turns stiff sheets into compliant, shape-morphing structures, but its reliance on periodic cut patterns comes at a cost: correlated panel rotations couple extension to shear, so stretching one axis drives a parasitic shear that cannot be suppressed, and also confine anisotropic stiffness to a narrow, discrete set of responses that cannot be tuned independently. Biological tissues overcome an analogous constraint through controlled disorder, such as graded fiber orientations in skin and hierarchical anisotropy in myocardium, achieving direction-dependent mechanics unavailable to regular architectures. Here, we show that engineered disorder is a design degree of freedom for kirigami, with stochastic kirigami accessing a continuous and far broader region of mechanical response than periodic patterns. This includes programmable anisotropy with near-complete elimination of extension-shear coupling. Because disordered patterns lack a simple parameterization, we navigate this design space with a geometry-aware graph neural network (GNN) that maps cut topology to the full nonlinear, bidirectional stress-strain response, coupled to a genetic algorithm that inverse-designs patterns reproducing target responses along two perpendicular axes. The GNN trains an order of magnitude faster and more accurately than image-based models. Fabricated elastomer samples reproduce the predicted nonlinear, anisotropic responses, closing the loop from design to physical component. By turning disorder into a variable to control directional stiffness, this work develops architected materials that stretch without parasitic shear, from soft actuators to tissue-interfacing devices matched to the anisotropy of living tissue.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用受控无序（工程化无序）作为剪纸超材料的设计自由度，通过几何感知图神经网络（GNN）结合遗传算法，实现了可编程各向异性力学响应，并几乎完全消除了拉伸-剪切耦合效应，实验验证了其预测的非线性各向异性行为。
AI.motivation: 传统剪纸依赖周期性切割图案，导致面板旋转耦合延伸与剪切，产生不可抑制的寄生剪切，且各向异性刚度局限于离散的、不可独立调节的响应。生物组织通过受控无序（如皮肤中的梯度纤维取向、心肌中的层级各向异性）克服了类似约束。受此启发，作者希望将工程化无序引入剪纸设计，以实现更宽泛、连续且可编程的力学响应。
AI.method: 1) 提出随机剪纸（stochastic kirigami）概念，利用无序切割图案作为设计自由度；2) 开发几何感知图神经网络（GNN），将切割拓扑映射到完整的非线性双向应力-应变响应；3) 结合遗传算法逆向设计，沿两个垂直轴复现目标响应；4) 通过弹性体样品 fabrication 实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 随机剪纸实现了比周期性图案更宽、更连续的力学响应区域；2) 几乎完全消除了延伸-剪切耦合，实现可编程各向异性；3) GNN训练速度比基于图像的模型快一个数量级，精度更高；4) 制造的弹性体样品准确复现了预测的非线性各向异性响应。
AI.conclusion: 通过将无序转化为可控变量来调节方向性刚度，本工作开发了无寄生剪切的可拉伸超材料，可应用于软体致动器以及与生物组织各向异性匹配的组织界面器件。

title: Frustration induced dimensional reduction and coexistence of long and short-range magnetic order in NdCl$_{3}$
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2+A1 tables, submitted to Physical Review B
summary: The phenomenon of frustration greatly enriches the accessible physics of quantum magnets. With this in mind we study the magnetism of NdCl$_{3}$ using a combination of bulk properties measurements and neutron scattering techniques. The low-temperature heat capacity reveals two magnetic transitions at $T_{N1}$ = 270 mK and $T_{N2}$ = 180 mK. However, much of the magnetic entropy is released above $T_{N1}$, manifesting as a broad peak centered at $T^{*} \approx$ 450 mK. Single crystal elastic neutron scattering reveals highly anisotropic magnetic diffuse scattering above $T_{N2}$, confirming that quasi-one-dimensional, short-range, antiferromagnetic order is the origin of the broad peak in the heat capacity. Magnetic Bragg peaks characterized by a $\vec{k}$ = ($0$ $0$ $\frac{1}{2}$) propagation vector emerge below $T_{N1}$. Interestingly, the magnetic diffuse scattering persists for $T_{N2} < T < T_{N1}$, indicating a regime of coexisting short and long-range order. The magnetic Bragg peaks exhibit an additional increase in intensity below $T_{N2}$ with no change in $\vec{k}$. Concomitantly, the diffuse scattering disappears indicating the attainment of full long-range order. While the precise nature of the ordered magnetic ground state remains unresolved, the observed magnetic scattering indicates predominate $c$-axis moments with a small $ab$-plane component. We propose that the quasi-one-dimensional behavior and the coexistence of short and long-range order are driven by frustration of anisotropic exchange interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过热容测量和中子散射技术研究了NdCl₃的磁性，发现其在270 mK和180 mK处存在两个磁相变，并观测到准一维短程反铁磁序与长程序共存的奇特现象，归因于各向异性交换相互作用的阻挫效应。
AI.motivation: 阻挫效应极大丰富了量子磁体的物理现象，本文旨在通过研究NdCl₃的磁性行为，探索阻挫在各向异性交换相互作用体系中的作用机制。
AI.method: 采用块材物性测量与中子散射技术相结合的方法，包括低温热容测量、单晶弹性中子散射等。
AI.result: 发现两个磁相变（T_N1=270 mK, T_N2=180 mK）；磁熵在T_N1以上释放形成宽峰（T*≈450 mK）；T_N2以上存在高度各向异性的磁弥散散射；T_N1以下出现k=(0 0 1/2)的磁布拉格峰；T_N2<T<T_N1区间存在短程与长程序共存；T_N2以下弥散散射消失，体系达到完全长程有序。
AI.conclusion: 准一维行为和短程-长程序共存归因于各向异性交换相互作用的阻挫；有序基态以c轴磁矩为主伴有小ab面分量。

title: A Voltage-Controlled Josephson Frequency Comb
summary: Microwave frequency combs constitute promising resources for quantum technologies, cryogenic electronics, and multiplexed sensing architectures. In this work, we propose a frequency-comb generator based on a Josephson field-effect transistor operated in a relaxation-oscillation regime. The device comprises a gate-tunable ballistic superconductor-semiconductor-superconductor junction embedded in a resistively shunted circuit, in which electrostatic control of the carrier density enables in situ tuning of both the critical current and the Josephson inductance. Time-domain circuit simulations indicate that the resulting oscillator produces coherent voltage pulses whose Fourier spectrum forms a microwave frequency comb. In contrast to conventional Josephson-based comb architectures, the proposed platform provides direct electrical control of the comb spacing, emission frequencies, and modal power distribution via a gate electrode. For a representative Al/InAs implementation, we demonstrate continuous frequency coverage in the technologically relevant 1-10 GHz range. Furthermore, the concept is shown to be compatible with higher-$T_c$ superconductors, underscoring its potential as a compact and scalable microwave source for cryogenic quantum information and sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于约瑟夫森场效应晶体管的微波频率梳发生器，通过静电调控实现梳齿间距、发射频率和功率分布的电气控制，在1-10 GHz范围内展示连续频率覆盖，并兼容高温超导体。
AI.motivation: 现有的约瑟夫森频率梳架构缺乏直接电控能力，亟需一种紧凑、可调谐且可扩展的微波频率梳源，以支持量子技术、低温电子学和复用传感架构。
AI.method: 将门可调的弹道超导体-半导体-超导体结嵌入电阻分流电路中，利用弛豫振荡模式产生相干电压脉冲；通过时域电路仿真分析输出频谱特性。
AI.result: 时域仿真表明该振荡器产生相干电压脉冲，傅里叶频谱形成微波频率梳；在Al/InAs实现中展示1-10 GHz连续频率覆盖；概念兼容高温超导体。
AI.conclusion: 该平台可作为紧凑、可扩展的微波源，为低温量子信息处理和传感应用提供直接电控的频率梳方案。

title: A Unified Discrete and Continuous Theory of Core-Halo Complexity Maximizers
summary: The maximization of statistical complexity has long been associated with the emergence of probability distributions lying between perfect order and complete disorder. While previous studies have shown that complexity-maximizing distributions exhibit a two-level structure in finite discrete systems, an analogous unified treatment for both discrete and continuous probability spaces has remained unavailable. In this work, we develop a general variational framework for a generalized statistical complexity constructed from Shannon and Renyi entropies. We derive a common stationary equation governing both discrete probability masses and continuous probability densities and prove that every stationary solution necessarily possesses exactly two probability levels, establishing a universal core-halo structure. We further demonstrate that the optimization problem reduces to a single multiplicity parameter and prove that the global complexity maximum is attained by the smallest admissible core, corresponding to a single dominant state in the discrete case and an infinitesimal core in the continuous limit. These results provide a complete analytical characterization of the complexity-maximizing distributions and reveal a common mathematical structure underlying complexity optimization in both discrete and continuous settings. The framework establishes a unified foundation for generalized statistical complexity with potential applications in statistical mechanics, information theory, and the analysis of complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个广义统计复杂度的变分框架，推导出离散和连续概率空间共同的平稳方程，证明所有平稳解必然具有两个概率水平（核心-晕结构），并证明全局复杂度最大值由最小允许核心实现（离散中为单一主导态，连续中为无穷小核心）。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明复杂度最大化分布在有限离散系统中呈现双层结构，但缺乏同时适用于离散和连续概率空间的统一处理框架。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于Shannon和Renyi熵构建广义统计复杂度的变分框架，推导平稳方程，通过数学证明分析离散概率质量和连续概率密度的共同结构，将优化问题简化为单一重数参数。
AI.result: ①所有平稳解必然具有恰好两个概率水平（核心-晕结构）；②优化问题可简化为单一重数参数；③全局复杂度最大值由最小允许核心实现（离散：单一主导态；连续：无穷小核心）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为离散和连续设定下的复杂度优化建立了统一的数学基础，对统计力学、信息论和复杂系统分析具有潜在应用价值。

title: Colored $Δ_T$ noise probes the topological character of edge modes
summary: We investigate colored $Δ_T$ noise, i.e., finite-frequency $Δ_T$ noise, as a probe of edge-mode (EM) transport in quantum Hall and quantum spin Hall systems. Colored $Δ_T$ noise probes finite-frequency nonequilibrium current fluctuations and dynamical transport properties that are often obscured in DC measurements of conductance and noise. Since $Δ_T$ noise is driven solely by a temperature and voltage bias under zero average charge current conditions, it eliminates current-induced Joule heating and directly probes intrinsic thermal fluctuations. We show that chiral, spin-conserving helical, and spin-flip helical (trivial) EMs exhibit distinct colored $Δ_T$-noise signatures under appropriate bias protocols. Incorporating energy-dependent scattering through a quantum point contact, we demonstrate that electron-hole asymmetry significantly modifies the finite-frequency spectrum while preserving these distinguishing features. Notably, colored $Δ_T$ noise exhibits a frequency-dependent sign reversal absent in the corresponding white ($ω=0$) $Δ_T$ noise. We further investigate zero-temperature colored quantum shot noise and find that it vanishes identically for chiral EMs, whereas the spin-conserving helical response changes sign with frequency. By contrast, spin-flip helical (trivial) EMs exhibit a positive colored shot-noise spectrum. However, the corresponding colored $Δ_T$ noise retains its characteristic sign reversal, providing a robust distinction between spin-conserving helical and spin-flip helical (trivial) EM transport. These results establish colored $Δ_T$ noise as a robust, experimentally accessible, complementary probe for identifying chiral, spin-conserving helical, and spin-flip helical (trivial) EM transport in mesoscopic topological systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究彩色Δ_T噪声（有限频率Δ_T噪声）作为量子霍尔和量子自旋霍尔系统中边缘模式传输的探针。作者发现手性、自旋守恒螺旋和自旋翻转螺旋（平庸）边缘模式在适当偏置协议下表现出不同的彩色Δ_T噪声特征，且该噪声在零平均电荷电流条件下由温度和电压偏置驱动，消除了焦耳热效应。频率依赖的符号反转是彩色Δ_T噪声区别于白色（ω=0）Δ_T噪声的关键特征。结果表明彩色Δ_T噪声是一种鲁棒且实验可行的互补探针，可用于区分拓扑边缘模式传输。
AI.motivation: 传统直流电导和噪声测量难以揭示有限频率下的动力学输运特性，且电流诱导的焦耳热会掩盖本征热涨落。作者希望通过研究彩色Δ_T噪声来探测边缘模式有限频率非平衡电流涨落，从而区分不同性质的边缘模式传输（手性、自旋守恒螺旋、自旋翻转螺旋）。
AI.method: 理论分析彩色Δ_T噪声在量子霍尔和量子自旋霍尔系统中的表现。通过在零平均电荷电流条件下施加温度和电压偏置驱动Δ_T噪声，引入量子点接触的能量依赖散射，研究电子-空穴不对称性对有限频率谱的修正，并与零温度彩色量子散粒噪声进行对比。
AI.result: 手性、自旋守恒螺旋和自旋翻转螺旋边缘模式表现出截然不同的彩色Δ_T噪声特征；电子-空穴不对称性可显著改变频谱但保留区分特征；彩色Δ_T噪声呈现频率依赖符号反转而在白色Δ_T噪声中不存在；零温彩色散粒噪声在手性边缘模式中恒为零，自旋守恒螺旋响应随频率改变符号，而自旋翻转螺旋呈现正谱。但彩色Δ_T噪声在所有情况下都保留其特征性符号反转，从而稳健区分三种边缘模式。
AI.conclusion: 彩色Δ_T噪声是一种鲁棒、实验可行且互补的探针，可用于区分介观拓扑系统中的手性、自旋守恒螺旋和自旋翻转螺旋（平庸）边缘模式传输。

title: Beyond Janus Atomic Ordering: High-Throughput First-Principles Search for Hidden MoSO Monolayer Structures
summary: Despite the growing interest in two-dimensional (2D) MoSO systems, existing studies have exclusively focused on conventional Janus structures. In this work, we perform high-throughput first-principles calculations to explore novel stable 2D MoSO monolayers. Combined with random sampling strategy, graph theory and group theory, we successfully screen out three novel non-Janus 2D MoSO monolayers from 1325 candidate structures, namely Reversed 2H-MoSO, Hybrid 2H-MoSO, and Hybrid 1T'-MoSO. Compared with Janus MoSO monolayers, the non-Janus MoSO counterparts possess lower binding energies, varying from -4.38 to -4.51 eV/atom. A systematic combination of dynamic, thermodynamic, and mechanical stability analyses corroborates their excellent structural robustness. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations confirm their superior thermal resistance, with the structures remaining stable at temperatures beyond 2000 K. Interestingly, unlike the semiconducting Janus MoSO, the Hybrid 1T'-MoSO monolayer exhibits distinct metallic characteristics. Furthermore, we found that strain and curvature can enable controlled phase transitions of MoSO among semiconducting, semimetallic, and metallic phases. More importantly, the Hybrid 1T'-MoSO exhibits favorable HER activity with a Gibbs free energy of -0.002 eV, rendering it a promising candidate for hydrogen evolution catalysis. This work not only expands the family of 2D MoSO materials but also provides a reliable strategy for discovering stable functional 2D materials via high-throughput computation.

AI.tldr: 通过高通量第一性原理计算，从1325种候选结构中筛选出三种非传统Janus结构的2D MoSO单层材料，发现Hybrid 1T'-MoSO具有金属特性和优异的HER催化活性（ΔG = -0.002 eV），且应变和曲率可实现相变调控。
AI.motivation: 现有2D MoSO研究仅关注传统Janus结构，缺乏对其他构型的探索。本文旨在发现新型稳定非Janus MoSO单层材料，扩展2D MoSO家族，并探索其电子性质和催化应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用高通量第一性原理计算，结合随机采样策略、图论和群论，从1325种候选结构中筛选非Janus MoSO单层；通过动力学、热力学和力学稳定性分析及AIMD模拟评估结构稳定性；采用DFT计算电子性质和HER催化活性。
AI.result: 筛选出三种非Janus MoSO单层：Reversed 2H-MoSO、Hybrid 2H-MoSO和Hybrid 1T'-MoSO；结合能低至-4.38至-4.51 eV/atom；AIMD显示结构在2000K以上仍稳定；Hybrid 1T'-MoSO呈金属性且HER活性出色（ΔG = -0.002 eV）；应变和曲率可实现半导体-半金属-金属相变。
AI.conclusion: 本研究不仅扩展了2D MoSO材料家族，发现具有优异HER催化活性的新型非Janus结构，还提供了一种高通量计算发现稳定功能二维材料的可靠策略。

title: Phonon dynamics in Chromium under pressure: absence of phonon criticality at the approach of the quantum critical point
summary: Fermi surface nesting is key to understanding the origin of the itinerant antiferromagnetic spin density wave in Chromium. At very low temperature, this density wave is destroyed above the critical pressure $P_c\approx$10~GPa, defining a quantum critical point. Strong electron-phonon coupling induces a small phonon softening close to the $H-$point of the Brillouin zone as well as close to the $H$-point. These phonon anomalies are known as Kohn anomalies. They remain unchanged down to 50K and are known to be present in both the paramagnetic and the antiferromagnetic phases. This paper presents inelastic X-ray scattering experiments on the phonon dispersion curves under pressure, up to $P=$15.6~GPa far above the critical pressure $P_c$. The softening of the well-known phonon anomalies is still present which leads to conclude that they do not play a major role at the antiferromagnetic ordering. Based on ab-initio calculation, the robustness of the Fermi surface nesting under pressure, explain the presence of these Kohn anomalies above the critical pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高压非弹性X射线散射实验（最高15.6 GPa）和第一性原理计算，发现在铬金属中，即使远高于反铁磁量子临界压力（~10 GPa），Kohn声子异常依然存在。这表明费米面嵌套在高压下保持稳健，而声子软化并非反铁磁序的关键驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 探究铬中巡游反铁磁自旋密度波在高压下的行为，特别是澄清声子反常（Kohn异常）与反铁磁序之间的因果关系。
AI.method: 采用高压非弹性X射线散射实验测量声子色散曲线，结合第一性原理（ab-initio）计算分析费米面嵌套的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在远高于临界压力Pc（最高15.6 GPa）的条件下，H点附近的Kohn声子软化现象仍然存在，且与低温（50K）下的观测结果一致。
AI.conclusion: Kohn声子异常并非反铁磁序的主导机制；费米面嵌套在高压下保持稳健，是解释该现象的关键。

title: Symmetry-Based Microscopic Theory of the Unconventional Pairing Mechanism in La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$
summary: Recent experiments report high-temperature superconductivity in the hybrid nickelate $\mathrm{La}_5\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{O}_{11}$, which is composed of alternating stacks of bilayer $\mathrm{La}_3\mathrm{Ni}_2\mathrm{O}_7$ and monolayer $\mathrm{La}_2\mathrm{NiO}_4$. However, the superconducting transition temperature $T_c \approx 64~\mathrm{K}$ for $\mathrm{La}_5\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{O}_{11}$ is remarkably lower than the $80~\mathrm{K}$ observed for pressurized $\mathrm{La}_3\mathrm{Ni}_2\mathrm{O}_7$. Thus, an unified microscopic theory is required to address the difference in the pairing mechanisms between these systems. Here, we develop a phenomenological symmetry-based approach to systematically analyze the low-energy physics in $\mathrm{La}_5\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{O}_{11}$, which is obtained by a charge self-consistent density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory method. We show that the superconductivity in $\mathrm{La}_5\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{O}_{11}$ exhibits a two-gap nature, consisting of a leading interlayer pairing between the $d_{z^2}$ orbitals and a subleading intralayer pairing between the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbitals. The reduction of $T_c$ can be attributed to the diminished contribution of the interlayer pairing, as reflected by the hopping parameter ratio $|t_{\perp}^z/t_{\parallel}^{x}|$. Base on this unified picture, we discuss the possible pairing mechanism and the role of $γ$ pocket for the superconductivity in the bilayer NiO$_2$ planes of nickelate superconductors.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对La5Ni3O11中高温超导转变温度（~64 K）低于加压La3Ni2O7（~80 K）的现象，通过DFT+DMFT方法发展了基于对称性的唯象分析，揭示了其双能隙超导本质：主导的层间d_z²轨道配对和次要的层内d_x²-y²轨道配对，并指出Tc降低源于层间配对被抑制，这可由跳跃参数比|t⊥^z/t∥^x|反映。
AI.motivation: 解释La5Ni3O11与La3Ni2O7之间超导转变温度的显著差异（64 K vs 80 K），并建立统一的微观理论来阐明两者的配对机制差异。
AI.method: 采用电荷自洽的密度泛函理论（DFT）结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）方法，发展基于对称性的唯象学方法来系统分析La5Ni3O11的低能物理。
AI.result: 发现La5Ni3O11的超导具有双能隙特征：主导的d_z²轨道层间配对和次要的d_x²-y²轨道层内配对；Tc降低归因于层间配对贡献减弱，这体现在跳跃参数比|t⊥^z/t∥^x|的减小。
AI.conclusion: 基于统一图像讨论了镍基超导体双层NiO2面中超导的配对机制以及γ pocket的作用。

title: Large scale behavior in the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation: The Schwinger-Dyson route
summary: The present paper is a study of the large scale properties of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation. By using a Schwinger-Dyson framework, we aim to provide a proof that the only solutions that can sustain a stable scaling in the infrared limit have a negative effective viscosity (in the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky sense) with a minimal set of hypotheses, thereby showing that this constitutes a general property of the wave equation that does not depend on a specific set of truncations of a renormalisation group flow, or limitations of a given numerical scheme for example.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Schwinger-Dyson框架研究Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程的大尺度性质，证明了在红外极限下能够维持稳定尺度的唯一解具有负有效粘度，且这一性质是波动方程的普遍特性，不依赖于重整化群流的具体截断或数值方案的局限。
AI.motivation: 希望严格证明Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程在红外极限下稳定尺度解具有负有效粘度这一性质的普遍性，摆脱对特定重整化群截断或数值方法的依赖。
AI.method: 采用Schwinger-Dyson框架进行理论分析，在最小假设集下推导红外极限的性质。
AI.result: 证明只有具有负有效粘度的解才能在红外极限下维持稳定尺度。
AI.conclusion: 负有效粘度是Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程（作为波动方程）的一种普遍性质，而非特定近似或数值方案的人为产物。

title: A field theory approach to Breit-type Hamiltonians in gapped Dirac systems
summary: We develop a path-integral-based field theory for deriving Breit-type low-energy Hamiltonians for gapped Dirac systems coupled to both vector and axial gauge fields. Treating the mass gap as the large energy scale, we integrate out the high-energy component of the Dirac spinor and obtain a canonical Schrödinger description for the remaining low-energy degrees of freedom. For the ordinary Dirac equation, our method reproduces the conventional Breit Hamiltonian order by order. In the presence of axial gauge fields, however, the resulting Hamiltonian contains additional vector-axial couplings that have no analogue in the traditional electromagnetic case. We illustrate the method using three- and two-dimensional Dirac models and discuss its relevance to gapped Weyl systems, where dynamical axial fields can generate distinctive low-energy transport signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种基于路径积分的场论方法，用于推导带隙狄拉克系统在矢量和轴矢量规范场耦合下的Breit型低能哈密顿量。通过将质量间隙视为大能标并积分出高能分量，得到了低能自由度满足的薛定谔方程。在普通狄拉克方程情形下复现了传统Breit哈密顿量，但在轴矢量规范场存在时，哈密顿量包含额外的矢量-轴矢量耦合项。利用三维和二维狄拉克模型进行了验证，并讨论了在带隙外尔系统中的潜在应用。
AI.motivation: 现有Breit哈密顿量理论主要针对常规电磁（矢量）规范场，而实际量子材料中可能存在轴矢量规范场（如应变、自旋轨道耦合等引起的赝规范场）。作者旨在建立一套系统的场论方法，将Breit型低能哈密顿量推广到同时包含矢量和轴矢量规范场的狄拉克系统，以捕捉这类系统中独特的低能物理。
AI.method: 基于路径积分的场论方法：将质量间隙视为大能量标度，对狄拉克旋量的高能分量进行积掉（积分-out），得到剩余低能自由度满足的规范薛定谔方程。对普通狄拉克方程逐阶展开可复现传统Breit哈密顿量；对含轴矢量规范场的系统，则通过类似路径积分处理得到包含矢量-轴矢量交叉耦合项的推广形式。
AI.result: ①在普通狄拉克方程情形下，方法逐阶复现了传统Breit哈密顿量，验证了方法的正确性；②在轴矢量规范场存在时，得到的哈密顿量包含传统电磁情形中不存在的新矢量-轴矢量耦合项；③通过三维和二维狄拉克模型进行了具体示范。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为研究带隙狄拉克系统在混合规范场下的低能物理提供了系统框架，特别适用于带隙外尔半金属等体系中由动力学轴矢量场产生的独特低能输运特征。

title: Universal Dynamic Scaling of 2D Quantum Ising Transition on the Fuzzy Sphere
comment: 4.5 pages with 4 figures in main text + 1.5 pages of appendix
summary: We revisit the problem of \textit{real-time} quantum dynamics of the paradigmatic two dimensional transverse-field Ising model using the recently developed fuzzy sphere regularization scheme. By linearly ramping the transverse field from the paramagnetic phase to criticality, we study the finite-time scaling behavior of the squared order parameter $\langle m_z^2 \rangle$, the excitation energy density $Q$, and the two-point correlation function of $m_z$. We establish numerically that, at intermediate quench rate, $\langle m_z^2 \rangle$ follows the conventional Kibble-Zurek prediction set by the critical exponents of the $3$D Ising universality class, and the correlation function exhibits the expected exponential decay whose correlation length can be used to estimate the non-universal scaling coefficient in the freeze-out time/length. In contrast, the excitation energy density $Q$ does not reach the same scaling regime at available system sizes due to large effective finite-size gap from symmetry-enforced level sparsity in the energy spectrum. At slow quench rates the universal quasi-adiabatic scaling for both $\langle m_z^2 \rangle$ and $Q$ is recovered. Since the fuzzy sphere construction can realize not only the Ising conformal field theory (CFT), but a broad family of $(2+1)d$ CFTs, our results establish a route to the real-time critical dynamics of strongly coupled CFTs that are otherwise computationally challenging to study.

AI.tldr: 本文利用模糊球正则化方案，重新研究了二维横场Ising模型的实时量子动力学问题。通过线性扫描横场从顺磁相到临界点，研究了序参量平方、激发能密度和两点关联函数的有限时间标度行为。在中等扫描速率下，序参量平方遵循Kibble-Zurek预测，关联函数呈指数衰减；而激发能密度因对称性导致的能谱稀疏性，在可用系统尺寸下未达到相同标度区。慢速扫描下恢复了准绝热标度。该工作为研究强耦合CFT的实时临界动力学开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以高效研究(2+1)d强耦合CFT的实时临界动力学，需要发展新的数值方案来探索这类系统的非平衡标度行为。
AI.method: 采用模糊球正则化方案，对二维横场Ising模型进行线性扫描（从顺磁相到临界点），通过有限时间标度分析研究序参量平方、激发能密度和两点关联函数的动力学行为。
AI.result: 1) 中等扫描速率下，<m_z^2>符合3D Ising普适类的Kibble-Zurek标度预测；2) 关联函数呈指数衰减，其关联长度可用于估计冻结时间/长度的非普适标度系数；3) 激发能密度Q因对称性导致的有限尺寸能隙影响，在可用尺寸下未进入相同标度区；4) 慢速扫描下恢复了准绝热标度。
AI.conclusion: 模糊球方法不仅能实现Ising CFT，还能推广到更多(2+1)d CFTs，为研究强耦合CFT的实时临界动力学建立了有效路径，解决了传统方法难以计算的问题。

title: Structural and Vibrational Properties of D$_3$Se from First Principles: Anharmonic Quantum and Isotope Effects
summary: Hydrogen-rich superconductors have garnered considerable interest following the discovery of hot superconductivity in high pressure H$_3$S, reviving prospects for room temperature superconductors under high-pressures. Using H$_3$Se as a reference system, we investigate the vibrational and superconducting properties of D$_3$Se in the Im\bar{3}m phase across 60-200 GPa by combining first-principles calculations with the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation to treat ionic quantum and anharmonic effects. These effects introduce significant renormalization to the phonon spectra and stabilize the lattice down to at least 70 GPa, well below the harmonic prediction of >110 GPa. Ultimately, the phonon renormalizations alter the electron-phonon coupling, introducing a decrease in the superconducting critical temperature by about 3-16 K across the studied pressure range with respect to standard calculations. Including anharmonic phonons within the Migdal-Eliashberg theory yields $T_c \approx 154$ K at 75 GPa (with $μ^* = 0.1$, $λ = 3.0$), highlighting D3Se as a promising high-Tc superconductor at moderate pressures. Examining the role of anharmonicity in the isotope effect, we find that at 200 GPa it suppresses the isotope coefficient $α$ to 0.29 one third below the harmonic value (0.44) which approaches the BCS limit of 0.5. This dramatic reduction demonstrates that anharmonicity fundamentally governs the isotope effect on this system. The stark discrepancy between anharmonic and harmonic descriptions underscores the need for targeted experimental efforts to resolve the origin of the persistent theory-experiment discrepancy in compressed hydrides.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算结合随机自洽谐波近似，研究了D₃Se在Im\bar{3}m相中(60-200 GPa)的离子量子效应和非谐效应，发现非谐效应显著重整化声子谱、稳定晶格结构，并导致超导临界温度降低3-16 K，在75 GPa下预测Tc≈154 K；同时非谐效应使同位素系数从0.44降至0.29，揭示了非谐性对同位素效应的根本调控作用。
AI.motivation: 高压氢基超导体(如H₃S)发现后，室温超导前景被重燃，但理论与实验之间持续存在分歧，因此需要准确处理离子量子效应和非谐效应以弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 以H₃Se为参考体系，采用第一性原理计算结合随机自洽谐波近似(SSCHA)处理离子量子效应和非谐效应，并用Migdal-Eliashberg理论计算超导临界温度。
AI.result: 非谐效应使晶格稳定至至少70 GPa(低于谐波预测的>110 GPa)；声子重整化使Tc降低3-16 K；75 GPa下Tc≈154 K(μ*=0.1, λ=3.0)；同位素系数α从0.44降至0.29。
AI.conclusion: D₃Se是中等压力下有前景的高温超导体；非谐性从根本上调控同位素效应；理论和谐波描述与实验结果之间的巨大差异需要通过针对性的实验努力来解决。

title: Expansion of a free Fermi gas released from an isotropic trapping potential
summary: We consider a system of non-interacting fermions prepared in the many-body ground state of an isotropic trapping potential in any dimension, and investigate the ballistic expansion of the fermionic cloud after the potential is suddenly released. Using semi-classical techniques, we derive the full late-time profile of the expanding cloud in the regime when the fermion number is large. We thus obtain explicit expressions for power-law potentials with arbitrary exponent $a$ and in all dimensions $d$. The momentum distribution and the spatial profile of the cloud exhibit a universal edge exponent $d/a$, thus generalizing the Wigner semi-circle law and the Thomas-Fermi distribution.

AI.tldr: 研究无相互作用费米子从各向同性陷阱释放后的弹道膨胀，推导出大粒子数极限下晚期的空间分布和动量分布的普适边缘指数 d/a，推广了Wigner半圆律和Thomas-Fermi分布。
AI.motivation: 理解费米子云在陷阱突然释放后的膨胀动力学，特别是寻找超越简单谐振子陷阱的普适规律，将已知的Wigner半圆律和Thomas-Fermi分布推广到任意幂律势阱。
AI.method: 采用半经典技术（semi-classical techniques），在费米子数很大的极限下，系统研究各向同性幂律势阱（指数a）中无相互作用费米子基态在势阱突然释放后的弹道膨胀，推导出任意维度d下的晚期轮廓。
AI.result: 得到了云团膨胀后期空间和动量分布的显式表达式，发现其边缘行为由普适指数 d/a 刻画，该指数仅依赖于势阱指数a和空间维度d。
AI.conclusion: 发现的普适边缘指数 d/a 推广了传统谐振子势（a=2）下的Wigner半圆律和Thomas-Fermi分布，揭示了冷原子膨胀动力学中更深层的标度律。

title: Symmetry-isolated magnetoelectric electro-optic effects in noncentrosymmetric metals
summary: We classify the symmetry-constrained forms of the Berry curvature dipole $\mathbf{D}$, gyrotropic magnetic tensor $\mathbf{K}$, and magnetoelectric electro-optic (EO) tensor $\mathbf{G}$, which describe metallic optical and EO effects in time-reversal symmetric, noncentrosymmetric metals. We identify 11 space groups (SGs) in which $\mathbf{D}$ and $\mathbf{K}$ vanish by symmetry while $\mathbf{G}$ remains allowed, thereby providing a more direct route to observing the recently predicted magnetoelectric EO effects associated with $\mathbf{G}$. First-principles based calculations confirm that $\mathbf{D}$ and $\mathbf{K}$ vanish for representative materials, while $\mathbf{G}$ remains allowed and tunable via Fermi level shifting. We further show that the choices of SG and experimental configuration provide complementary paths for isolating $\mathbf{G}$-driven EO effects, including cases where $\mathbf{D}$ and $\mathbf{K}$ are also symmetry-allowed. In an oblique-incidence geometry, the $\mathbf{D}$-driven response produces a helicity-even absorption or gain correction, whereas the $\mathbf{G}$-driven response couples the $s$ and $p$ optical sectors and produces a bias-induced circular dichroism with a characteristic $\sinθ\cosθ$ angular dependence. This provides a direct experimental route for separating the $\mathbf{D}$- and $\mathbf{G}$-driven EO signatures in noncentrosymmetric metals.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分类了时间反演对称非中心对称金属中Berry曲率偶极子D、回旋磁张量K和磁电电光张量G的对称性约束形式，识别出11个空间群中D和K因对称性消失而G仍允许存在，并通过第一性原理计算验证。同时提出了通过斜入射几何实验区分D和G驱动电光效应的直接方法。
AI.motivation: 为更直接地观测新近预测的G驱动的磁电电光效应，通过对称性分析识别出D和K消失而G仍允许存在的空间群，从而排除干扰信号。
AI.method: 采用对称性分类方法，对非中心对称金属中的D、K、G三张量进行系统约束分析；结合第一性原理计算验证代表性材料；设计斜入射几何实验方案以区分D和G的贡献。
AI.result: 识别出11个空间群中D和K对称性消失而G保持允许；第一性原理计算确认了代表性材料中D和K为零而G可调；斜入射几何中D驱动响应为螺旋性偶吸收修正，G驱动响应产生偏压诱导圆二色性，具有sinθcosθ角度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 提供了隔离G驱动电光效应的互补路径，包含D和K对称性禁止与允许两种情况；斜入射几何可有效分离D和G的电光信号，为实验观测磁电电光效应提供了直接途径。

title: Three Million Years Opposite State Data Retention in Partially Switched Wurtzite Ferroelectrics
summary: Ferroelectric memories based on the wurtzite-structured ferroelectrics are projected to store information for more than 3 million years at 150C. These results are extracted by combining standard domain wall motion limited switching kinetics with the near-by-electrode injection model for opposite state retention in ferroelectric random access memory. This impressive performance is greatly aided by switching only a fraction of the total polarization to store data, in order to limit the initial imprint variation of the devices - an effect that is universally observed in films with different thicknesses (60 nm - 270 nm) and different compounds (AlScN and AlScBN). Paradoxically, yet systematically, this reduction in initial imprint consistently results in larger switching polarization after a given time, compared to the fully switching state and 5-7 orders of magnitude improved opposite state retention. Finally, partial switching is able to simultaneously boost endurance against premature polarization loss and breakdown, making it a promising strategy for improved operation of ferroelectric devices with large spontaneous polarization, in particularly wurtzite-structured compounds.

AI.tldr: 基于纤锌矿结构铁电体的铁电存储器，通过部分极化翻转策略，在150°C下可实现超过300万年的信息保持能力，同时显著提升耐久性。
AI.motivation: 探索纤锌矿结构铁电体（如AlScN、AlScBN）在铁电存储器中的应用潜力，解决传统铁电器件在高温下保持性能差、极化退化等问题。
AI.method: 结合标准畴壁运动限制的开关动力学与近电极注入模型，采用部分极化翻转策略，在60-270nm不同厚度薄膜及不同化合物中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 部分翻转策略将初始印迹变化降至最低，使翻转极化量更大，反态保持时间提升5-7个数量级，在150°C下信息保持超300万年，同时提升抗极化退化和击穿耐久性。
AI.conclusion: 部分极化翻转是一种普适且有效的策略，能显著改善高自发极化铁电器件（尤其是纤锌矿结构化合物）的保持性能和耐久性。

title: Color superconductors and holon metals from doping a Fractional Chern insulator
summary: We develop a unified framework for metallic and superconducting phases obtained by doping a fractional Chern insulator (FCI) with $C=1/3$. Starting from the parton construction $c(\mathbf r)=f_1(\mathbf r)f_2(\mathbf r)f_3(\mathbf r)$, the low-energy theory has $SU(3)_{\mathrm{gauge}}\times SU(3)_{\mathrm{valley}}$ symmetry and nine Fermi pockets formed by charge-$-e/3$ holons $ψ_{ab}$, where $a$ and $b$ label color and valley. Viewing the holons as quarks connects this problem to color superconductivity in high-energy physics. Color-antisymmetric pairing produces a class of charge-$2e$ superconductors with angular momentum $L=3n$ and chiral central charge $c_-=m/2$, where $m$ is odd. Thus a gas of charge-$e/3$ anyons can enter a superconducting phase directly without binding. Particle--hole color--valley Higgs fields instead produce two $Z_3$ orthogonal metals with one or three pockets, transforming respectively as a singlet or triplet of $SU(3)_{\mathrm{valley}}$. A $U(1)^2$ holon metal with three identical pockets can preserve the triangular-lattice space group while reducing the emergent valley symmetry down to $S_3$. Its pairing instabilities include a gapped charge $2e$ $f-if$ superconductor and a gapless charge-$2e$ orthogonal superconductor with $\langle cc\rangle=0$ and a Bogoliubov Fermi surface at $Γ$. Finally, we discuss the possibility of a chemical-potential-tuned transition from the FCI to superconductivity and argue that all nine fermions may be required if the transition preserves the full emergent $SU(3)_v$ symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了掺杂分数陈绝缘体（FCI）的金属态和超导态的统一理论框架，通过部分子构造和色超导类比，预言了多种新奇物相。
AI.motivation: 理解掺杂分数陈绝缘体后出现的金属态和超导态，建立统一的理论描述。
AI.method: 采用部分子构造c=f1f2f3，将问题映射到SU(3)规范×SU(3)谷对称性下的费米口袋系统，并借助高能物理中的色超导理论进行分析。
AI.result: 发现了多种物相：色反对称配对导致的角动量L=3n的手征超导态；粒子-空穴凝聚产生的Z3正交金属态；U(1)^2荷子金属及其配对不稳定性（包括f-if超导体和正交超导体）。
AI.conclusion: 电荷e/3任意子可直接配对形成超导态，无需先束缚为电子；化学势调控可从FCI连续过渡到超导态。

title: Superconductivity in MgHCu3 perovskite revisited
comment: 13 pages, 3 Figures, 1 Table, and Supplementary Information of 9 pages
summary: We reexamine the crystal structure, electronic structure, lattice dynamics, phonon dispersion, electron-phonon coupling, and superconducting properties of MgHCu3 perovskite using the PBEsol and PBE functionals. This perovskite phase was recently proposed to exhibit superconductivity with the critical superconducting temperature, TC, of 42 K, which falls slightly over the classical 40 K limit for the phonon driven superconductivity. We show that although the crystal and electronic structure of this hypothetical compound are quite robust with respect to the k point mesh and functional used, yet the phonons and phonon related properties are extremely sensitive to the density of the grid chosen as well as functional used for calculations. Correspondingly, the values of the critical superconducting temperature calculated here for different Gaussian broadenings vary in a broad range of ca. 10 to 31 K and they do not exceed the classical limit. We suggest that the properties of this and many other high TC hydrides claimed should be thoroughly scrutinized using a variety of functionals, and benchmarked with experiment, to provide more reliable values of TC.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了MgHCu3钙钛矿的晶体结构、电子结构、晶格动力学、声子色散、电声耦合及超导性质。研究发现，虽然该化合物的晶体和电子结构对不同k点网格和泛函表现稳健，但声子及声子相关性质对计算网格密度和泛函选择极为敏感。计算的超导临界温度TC在约10-31K范围内变化，并未超过经典极限40K。
AI.motivation: 作者重新审视MgHCu3钙钛矿的超导性质，因为该化合物曾被报道具有42K的超导临界温度，略超经典声子驱动超导的40K极限。作者怀疑这一结论的可靠性，希望通过更严谨的计算验证其是否真正突破经典极限。
AI.method: 采用PBEsol和PBE两种泛函，结合不同k点网格密度和高斯展宽，系统计算MgHCu3的晶体结构、电子结构、声子色散、电声耦合及超导临界温度，分析各参数对计算结果的影响。
AI.result: MgHCu3的晶体和电子结构对不同k点网格和泛函表现稳健，但声子及超导相关性质高度敏感。不同高斯展宽下计算的TC范围约为10-31K，均未超过40K的经典极限。
AI.conclusion: MgHCu3的超导临界温度并未突破经典声子驱动的40K极限；许多其他宣称高TC的氢化物超导体应使用多种泛函并利用实验进行基准测试，以提供更可靠的TC值。

title: Tilted Anisotropic Dirac Fermions in an Exponentially Decaying Magnetic Field
summary: We develop an analytical theory of Landau quantization for tilted anisotropic Dirac fermions in an exponentially decaying magnetic field. Using anisotropy scaling and a Lorentz transformation, we recast the laboratory-frame problem into the isotropic Dirac equation in the boosted frame, where the exponentially decaying magnetic-field problem admits an exact solution. Transforming the boosted-frame spectrum back to the laboratory frame yields an implicit quantization condition with an intrinsically energy-dependent guiding-center parameter. We identify the conditions for physically admissible states. We further show that the formalism recovers the known uniform-field spectrum of tilted anisotropic Dirac fermions in the appropriate limit. Our results establish a unified Lorentz-covariant framework for describing Landau quantization in tilted anisotropic Dirac materials in the presence of an exponentially decaying magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了倾斜各向异性狄拉克费米子在指数衰减磁场中朗道量子化的解析理论，通过各向异性缩放和洛伦兹变换将问题映射到各向同性狄拉克方程，得到了隐式量子化条件，并统一描述了倾斜各向异性狄拉克材料中的朗道量子化现象。
AI.motivation: 研究倾斜各向异性狄拉克费米子（如有机导体α-(BEDT-TTF)₂I₃等）在非均匀磁场（特别是指数衰减磁场）中的朗道量子化行为，目前缺乏统一的解析理论框架。
AI.method: 采用各向异性缩放和洛伦兹变换，将实验室坐标系中的倾斜各向异性问题转化为助推坐标系中的各向同性狄拉克方程，其中指数衰减磁场问题可精确求解。通过反变换得到实验室坐标系的隐式量子化条件。
AI.result: 推导了具有能量依赖引导中心参数的隐式量子化条件；确定了物理允许态的判据；证明该理论在均匀磁场极限下可恢复已知的倾斜各向异性狄拉克费米子能谱。
AI.conclusion: 建立了描述倾斜各向异性狄拉克材料在指数衰减磁场中朗道量子化的统一洛伦兹协变框架，为相关实验现象提供理论基础。

title: Period-dependent suppression of Fourier peaks for topography images: Analysis of periodicity of triple-step arrays on vicinal Si(h h m) surfaces
summary: Reliable determination of the periodicity of multiatomic steps on high-Miller-index vicinal surfaces is often complicated by (i) the presence of relatively narrow terraces tilted at large angles relative to the scanning plane, and (ii) unavoidable distortions in the lateral direction resulting from creep and improper calibration of a piezo scanner. We argue that the period of the triple-step arrays on vicinal Si(5\,5\,6) and Si(5 5 7) single-crystal wafers can be determined from raw scanning tunneling microscopy data, without preliminary corrections, with precision approaching the interatomic distance. We demonstrate that the intensity of the Fourier peaks of the differential maps, derived from raw topography images by the difference-of-Gaussians approach, strongly depends on the period of the ordered triple-step arrays. This suppression of the ninth Fourier peak indicates that the regular array of triple steps has a period of $18b=5.99$ nm in projection onto the Si(1 1 1) terrace plane, where $b=0.333$ nm is the distance between atomic rows of the $1\times 1$ lattice in the $[\bar{1}\,\bar{1}\,2]$ direction. This means that the nominally (5\,5\,7)-oriented Si wafers may correspond locally to the Si(8 8 11) orientation. The method can be applied to the precise analysis of other vicinal surfaces with narrow and wide terraces containing an integer number of Si(1 1 1)$7\times 7$ unit cells.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需预处理即可从原始STM数据中高精度确定高米勒指数邻晶面多原子台阶周期的方法，并成功应用于Si(5 5 6)和Si(5 5 7)表面，发现名义上的Si(5 5 7)可能对应Si(8 8 11)取向。
AI.motivation: 高米勒指数邻晶面上多原子台阶周期的可靠测定存在两大困难：窄台阶面倾斜角度大导致扫描困难，以及压电扫描器的蠕变和校准误差引起横向畸变。现有方法需要复杂校正，亟需一种无需预处理的高精度测定方法。
AI.method: 采用差分高斯方法从原始STM形貌图像中提取差分图，分析其傅里叶峰值强度与三原子台阶阵列周期的依赖关系，通过第九傅里叶峰的抑制现象确定台阶周期。
AI.result: 三原子台阶规则阵列在Si(1 1 1)台面投影上的周期为18b=5.99 nm（b=0.333 nm），表明名义上的(5 5 7)取向Si晶片可能局部对应Si(8 8 11)取向。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可推广至其他含有整数个Si(1 1 1)7×7单胞的窄宽台面邻晶面的精确分析。

title: Tunable Superconductivity Mediated by Heavy-Electron Plasmons: Band-Structure and Quantum-Geometric Engineering
summary: Conventional superconductivity derives its pairing glue from lattice vibrations, tying its characteristic scales to chemistry and atomic masses. Plasmons$-$the collective oscillations of electrons$-$can instead be reshaped through electronic structure engineering, but the principles governing optimal plasmon-mediated pairing remain unclear. Here, we establish such principles for two-carrier systems in which heavy-electron plasmons mediate the pairing of light electrons. Within the random-phase approximation and Eliashberg theory, we calculate the optimal $T_c$ of minimal metallic models and show that it is controlled by a competition between the plasmon energy scale and retardation-driven suppression of the repulsion, yielding optimal carrier densities and band masses. While the plasmon channel alone reaches only $T_c\sim$ 0.1 K, a moderate phonon attraction cooperates with it, boosting $T_c$ by two orders of magnitude to above 20 K. However, the band flattening needed for slow metallic plasmons also favors the development of competing orders. We therefore consider an insulating system in which coherent interband transitions between flat bands generate gapped interband plasmons without free carriers. The heavy-band quantum metric governs the dispersion and electron-plasmon pairing strength of the interband plasmon, while the quantum geometry of the light band suppresses static screening and enhances the net attraction. Because layer separation rapidly weakens pairing, we propose systems with coexisting light and heavy electrons living in different mirror-symmetry sectors of the same layer as promising platforms. Our results establish a new role for flat-band systems in superconductivity: rather than hosting the paired electrons themselves, they can serve as a tunable pairing mediator whose collective charge excitations set the superconducting energy scale beyond their narrow bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了双载流子体系中等离子体介导的超导配对机制，提出了优化高温超导的理论原理。研究发现，等离子体通道单独只能达到~0.1K的Tc，但与中等声子吸引合作可将Tc提升两个数量级至20K以上。论文还探讨了平带系统中的量子几何效应用于增强超导配对，并提出了同一层中不同镜像对称扇区的轻/重电子共存的实验平台。
AI.motivation: 传统超导依赖于晶格振动（声子）作为配对胶水，其特征尺度受限于化学性质和原子质量。等离子体（电子的集体振荡）可以通过电子结构工程调控，但尚未明确最优等离子体介导配对的原理。本文旨在建立双载流子体系中这种配对原理。
AI.method: 在随机相位近似（RPA）和Eliashberg理论的框架下，计算了最小金属模型的优化Tc。分析了等离子体能量尺度与延迟效应压制排斥作用之间的竞争，确定了最优载流子密度和能带质量。同时考虑了平带绝缘体中的带间等离子体机制。
AI.result: 等离子体通道单独只能达到约0.1K的Tc；但中等声子吸引与等离子体通道合作，可将Tc提升两个数量级至20K以上。平带系统的量子度量（quantum metric）决定了带间等离子体的色散和电子-等离子体配对强度，而轻带的量子几何能够压制静态屏蔽并增强净吸引。
AI.conclusion: 平带系统在超导中扮演了新的角色：不是作为配对电子本身的主载体，而是作为可调的配对中介，其集体电荷激发将超导能标设定在窄带宽之外。提出同一层中不同镜像对称扇区的轻/重电子共存体系是极具前景的实验平台。

title: Depth Determination of Individual Shallow NV-Centers via Spin-Lock NMR
summary: Quantitative quantum sensing with shallow electron spins, such as those hosted by nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, requires accurate knowledge of the spin's depth below the host material's surface. A widely used approach infers this depth from the 1H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) signal of immersion oil on the diamond surface that can be detected using dynamical decoupling sequences such as XY8. However, finite-width pulses make XY8 sensitive to subharmonic responses, including unwanted contributions from nearby 13C spins, and its instrument-limited spectral resolution provides only sparse sampling of the narrow 1H NMR lineshape. Here, we introduce Spin-Lock NMR as an alternative approach to single-NV depth determination. By tuning the Spin-Lock Rabi frequency to the 1H Larmor frequency, the NV probes the 1H NMR signal through the Hartmann-Hahn resonance without the harmonic ambiguities of pulsed decoupling sequences and with substantially higher instrument-limited spectral resolution. We derive a quantitative Spin-Lock NMR fit function from a Markovian master equation that directly relates the measured spectrum to the NV depth. Our approach yields NV depth estimates in excellent agreement with the established XY8-based protocol across multiple NV centers and establishes Spin-Lock NMR as a robust alternative for quantitative single-NV depth determination. To demonstrate its applicability, we employ our method to investigate the 1H nuclear spin signal that is regularly reported to be present on diamond, even in the absence of immersion oil.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spin-Lock NMR替代传统XY8协议，通过Hartmann-Hahn共振精确测定NV色心深度，避免了脉冲序列的谐波模糊和仪器限制，实验验证其与XY8结果高度一致，并应用于无浸油时金刚石表面1H信号的研究。
AI.motivation: 传统基于XY8脉冲序列的NV深度测量方法存在两个关键缺陷：有限宽度脉冲导致的次谐波响应（13C自旋干扰）和仪器限制的频谱分辨率不足，无法精细采样窄1H NMR线形，亟需更精确、鲁棒的替代方案。
AI.method: 引入Spin-Lock NMR技术，通过将Spin-Lock Rabi频率调谐至1H Larmor频率，利用Hartmann-Hahn共振探测1H NMR信号；基于马尔可夫主方程推导定量拟合函数，直接关联测量谱与NV深度。
AI.result: 在多个NV色心上，Spin-Lock NMR得到的深度估计与XY8协议高度一致；证明了该方法对无浸油条件下金刚石表面存在的1H核自旋信号的有效探测能力。
AI.conclusion: Spin-Lock NMR是一种稳健、高精度的单NV深度测定替代方案，可消除谐波模糊并提高频谱分辨率，对于定量量子传感和表面物理研究具有重要价值。

title: Measuring momentum-resolved dissipation of phonon-polaritons in LiNbO$_3$ with terahertz driving
summary: Mapping the dispersion of polaritons, hybrid quasiparticles arising from light-matter coupling, can provide key insights into the material dielectric response, coupling strength, and energy transfer pathways with other excitations. In this work, we present THz pump-Raman probe (TP-RP) as a versatile method for mapping the polariton dispersion in polar non-centrosymmetric materials, demonstrated here for the case of phonon-polaritons in LiNbO$_3$. By resonantly driving polaritonic modes with a broadband THz pump and probing them with a tunable NIR Raman pulse, TP-RP allows for the extraction of the momentum-dependence of both their frequency and damping rate with high accuracy. The spectral features observed in the pump-probe signal, including the polaritonic response as well as pulse artifacts, are reproduced within a many-body theoretical approach. Applying the technique to study the E(TO$_1$) phonon of LiNbO$_3$ enables the combined analysis of theory and experiments to uncover a nontrivial frequency dependence of the phonon intrinsic damping rate, revealing possible anharmonic couplings to other modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出太赫兹泵浦-拉曼探测（TP-RP）作为一种通用方法，用于映射极性非中心对称材料中的极化激元色散。以LiNbO₃中的声子-极化激元为例，该方法通过宽带太赫兹泵浦共振驱动极化激元模式，并用可调谐近红外拉曼脉冲探测，能够高精度提取其频率和阻尼随动量的依赖关系。结合多体理论分析，揭示了E(TO₁)声子本征阻尼率中非平凡的频率依赖关系，暗示了与其他模式可能的非简谐耦合。
AI.motivation: 映射极化激元的色散关系对于理解材料的介电响应、耦合强度以及与其它激发的能量转移路径至关重要。现有方法在获取高精度动量分辨的色散和阻尼信息方面存在局限，因此需要发展一种更具通用性和精度的技术。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹泵浦-拉曼探测（TP-RP）技术：先用宽带太赫兹脉冲共振驱动极化激元模式，再用可调谐近红外拉曼脉冲探测。结合多体理论框架对泵浦-探测信号中的极化激元响应和脉冲伪影进行建模和解析。
AI.result: 成功提取了LiNbO₃中极化激元的频率和阻尼率随动量变化的色散关系。发现E(TO₁)声子的本征阻尼率存在非平凡的频率依赖性，揭示了可能的非简谐耦合通道。
AI.conclusion: TP-RP是一种通用且高精度的极化激元色散映射方法；理论与实验的联合分析可以揭示声子本征阻尼的复杂频率依赖关系，为研究材料中的非简谐耦合和能量耗散机制提供了新途径。

title: Nonreciprocal Superconducting Transport from Chiral Edge States
summary: Nonreciprocal superconducting transport enables dissipationless rectification and has attracted considerable interest, yet its microscopic origin is typically sought in bulk electronic states. Here, we show that boundary-controlled chiral edge states in topological systems provide a simple yet largely overlooked mechanism for nonreciprocal superconducting transport. Focusing on chiral kagome antiferromagnets, we demonstrate that out-of-plane spin canting or spin-orbit coupling opens a high-Chern-number bulk gap, giving rise to multiple chiral edge modes. Strikingly, sublattice-dependent boundary termination selects a single-valley character for the edge states, leading to asymmetric edge spectra at opposite edges. This boundary asymmetry directly yields observable nonreciprocal signatures in Josephson junctions oriented transverse to the edges, including asymmetric Andreev spectra, Josephson diode effect, and anomalous Fraunhofer interference patterns. These findings broaden the microscopic understanding of superconducting nonreciprocity and highlight boundary engineering as a tunable route toward superconducting diode devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑系统中的手性边缘态为超导非互易输运提供了一种被忽视的新机制。以手性kagome反铁磁体为例，边界终止选择导致边缘态呈现单谷特征，在约瑟夫森结中产生非互易信号，如约瑟夫森二极管效应和反常Fraunhofer干涉图案。
AI.motivation: 传统上，超导非互易输运的微观起源被归因于体电子态。作者希望揭示边界控制的手性边缘态这一被忽视的机制，拓宽对超导非互易性的微观理解。
AI.method: 以手性kagome反铁磁体为模型系统，通过面外自旋倾斜或自旋-轨道耦合打开高陈数体带隙，产生多重手性边缘模。利用依赖于子晶格的边界终止选择，使边缘态呈现单谷特征，导致相对边缘的不对称边缘谱。
AI.result: 在垂直于边缘的约瑟夫森结中观测到：不对称的Andreev谱、约瑟夫森二极管效应以及反常的Fraunhofer干涉图案。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现拓宽了对超导非互易性的微观理解，并突显了边界工程作为实现可调谐超导二极管器件的一种路径。

title: Impurity-induced Inverse Faraday Effect
summary: We provide a quantum-mechanical description of the photoinduced dc current states and magnetic fields around nonmagnetic point impurities in a two-dimensional (2D) electron gas irradiated by a circularly polarized electromagnetic wave. Based on the solution of the corresponding time-dependent Schrodinger equation within the second-order perturbation theory in the electromagnetic wave amplitude we find that the resulting dc magnetic field component perpendicular to the plane of the 2D system is distributed like in a set of random magnetic fluxes bound to the positions of impurities. As a result, the spatially averaged dc magnetic field does not vanish far from the sample edges and, thus, our scenario of the inverse Faraday effect in disordered systems differs strongly from the standard one based on the relaxation time approximation within the hydrodynamic or kinetic equation approaches which would give only the photoinduced currents flowing along the sample edges. The predicted mechanism for formation of rectified currents flowing around the impurity centers is shown to be generic both for 2D and three-dimensional systems. The internal dc magnetic field can give rise to the photoinduced Hall effect and Faraday rotation for a probing electromagnetic signal.

AI.tldr: 本文从量子力学角度描述了二维电子气中非磁性点杂质在圆偏振光照射下产生的光致直流电流和磁场，发现杂质周围会形成类似随机磁通分布的直流磁场分量，与传统逆法拉第效应的边缘电流图像不同，该机制适用于2D和3D系统，并可导致光致霍尔效应和法拉第旋转。
AI.motivation: 传统逆法拉第效应理论基于弛豫时间近似，预测光致电流仅沿样品边缘流动；作者希望揭示无序系统中杂质对光致电流和磁场的具体影响，解决理论与实际系统间的差异。
AI.method: 基于含时薛定谔方程，采用电磁波振幅的二阶微扰理论求解，分析圆偏振光照射下二维电子气中非磁性点杂质周围的量子力学响应。
AI.result: 发现直流磁场垂直于二维系统平面的分量在杂质位置周围呈类似随机磁通分布，空间平均后的直流磁场在远离样品边缘处不为零；该机制对2D和3D系统均适用。
AI.conclusion: 提出了无序系统中逆法拉第效应的全新量子力学机制，预测了内部直流磁场可导致光致霍尔效应和探测电磁信号的法拉第旋转，拓展了对光与物质相互作用的理解。

title: Physics-constrained machine learning for decoding multi-nanobubble configurations in graphene
summary: Identifying multiple graphene nanobubbles from electronic spectra is challenging because their strain-induced features overlap. We develop a physics-constrained machine-learning framework that decodes nanobubble configurations from density-of-states (DOS) spectra. For spatially separated nanobubbles, previous full quantum-transport calculations established that the multi-bubble DOS is numerically equivalent to the normalized sum of the constituent single-bubble spectra. We encode this validated additive relation in a compact neural decomposition model. For each target spectrum, the basis coefficients are optimized independently, and the resulting weights directly identify the constituent geometries. The method accurately reconstructs configurations of increasing complexity and remains robust to repeated constituents, incomplete basis dictionaries, and simulated measurement noise. The framework provides an interpretable route for characterizing strain-engineered graphene nanostructures and may extend to other quantum materials with additive spectral responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一种物理约束的机器学习框架，通过分解电子态密度谱来识别石墨烯纳米气泡的构型，解决了多气泡谱特征重叠的难题。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯纳米气泡的应变诱导特征在电子谱中高度重叠，导致从电子谱中识别多个纳米气泡的构型极具挑战性。
AI.method: 基于已验证的叠加原理（多气泡DOS等于单气泡谱的归一化和），构建了一个紧凑的神经分解模型。对每个目标谱独立优化基系数，通过权重直接识别组成几何结构。
AI.result: 该方法能准确重建复杂度递增的构型，对重复组分、不完整基字典和模拟测量噪声均具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为表征应变工程石墨烯纳米结构提供了可解释的途径，并可推广至其他具有可加性谱响应的量子材料。

title: Electrical Control of Altermagnetism in a Quasi-1D Magnet
summary: Altermagnetism is a collinear magnetic state characterized by momentum-dependent spin splitting in fully compensated materials. While widely investigated in systems governed by three- or two-dimensional exchange interactions, its extension to quasi-one-dimensional magnets remains almost unexplored.
